name: searchTerm
label: Search term
description: Search term to show in the input box

name: searchContextConfigId
label: Search configuration
description: Search configuration from the sys_search_context_config table

name: placeholder
label: Placeholder
description: Placeholder text to display in the input box before a user enters a value

name: nowAssistPlaceholder
label: AI Placeholder
defaultValue: Ask AI for help or search
description: Placeholder text to display in the input box before a user enters a value when ServiceNow Otto is enabled

name: placement
label: Placement
description: Specify where the component is displayed

name: size
label: Size
description: Specify if the mobile or desktop version should be displayed

name: showUtterances
label: Show Suggested ServiceNow Otto Utterances
description: Shows Suggested ServiceNow Otto Utterances if they are available from the suggestions api

name: additionalContext
label: Additional Context
description: Optional stringified JSON object to pass additional context when retrieving suggestions related to ServiceNow Otto, such as Suggested Utterances.
